posts.title: php2shell, Two Critical PHP Bugs Leaked Before the Patch
posts.description: PHP ships an emergency security release today, October 21, 2026, at 14:00 UTC. The release fixes two critical bugs in PHP core. People already call them “php2shell”. The details leaked one day before the embargo ended, so the clock started early for everybody who runs PHP. I wrote this post with what was public at 08:00 UTC on October 21. The fix is out now, so start with the next section.
